[[The Pain Eater]] is a [[unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[The Pain Eater (boss)|The Pain Eater]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Drazach Thicket]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +10 (vs. [[Slashing damage]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Channeling Focus]] [[dye]]d red.

==Replica==
Except for the [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create an exact replica for this item. Inscriptions on replicas provide core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*[[Channeling Focus]] from collector [[Danira]]
*[[Perfect]] "The Riddle of Steel" [[inscription]]
OR
*Channeling Focus from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*Perfect [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "The Riddle of Steel" inscription
AND
*Red [[dye]]
